surface: The check all checkbox of a checkbox column's header: its name with the count, its mixed state, and Space checking and unchecking the whole column.

steps.note: Navigable headers let ArrowUp enter the Done header, which holds the check all checkbox: `Check all (1 of 5 checked)` (the read-only row is not counted), mixed. Finding: no reader says the mixed state: the header cell holds the focus, and its name carries only the count. Finding: VoiceOver says nothing on this first arrow key, as on every scenario of this page.

Space on a mixed header checks every cell it counts, and the header's name changes under the focus. Finding: the check all header announces nothing, unlike row selection's select all, so with Chromium NVDA and VoiceOver say nothing; NVDA with Firefox and VoiceOver with WebKit read the renamed header (`Check all (5 of 5 checked)`).
Space again unchecks them. Finding: silent with Chromium, as the check above.

Space checks Task 0's cell. Nothing is required: the header's name holds the word checked, so a state group here would pass on the header alone (checkbox-cell reads the cells' states with the header off).
Back on the header: its count follows the cell, and it is mixed again. Finding: the mixed state is not read here either.
